label: Contingent spacetime grounding implies an unlocated underived root (inference)
rule: same-witness necessary-root elimination plus explicit whole-grounding bridge
meaning: Conditional cross-family consequence from the existing necessary-concrete-underived root-route node to a selected non-spatiotemporal attribute: the SAME underived concrete candidate is unlocated (dimensive SPATIOTEMPORAL_2) if the SAME world contains a contingent, actual concrete spacetime whole, and that very whole grounds every distinct located actual concretum in the SAME Profile.grounds relation. The whole's existence, contingency, and occupant-to-whole existential dependence are explicitly open premises; the latter is not derived from Leibniz/Clarke translation symmetry, Lorentz geometry, temporal ordering or efficient causation. The omission control has actual distinct concreta and a real grounding edge but no occupant-to-whole bridge or nonlocated root; the companion joint model satisfies all four premises with a located occupant distinct from the whole, and the companion control shows that dropping the Located antecedent makes the bridge inconsistent with the other three premises. Nonlocation is relative to the one supplied frame F. The result does not identify this witness with the GOD_4 attribute root, imply physical spacetime's contingency, or yield Boethian eternity; the next open consumer needs only its own GOD_4 bearer UnderivedConcreteAt in the same profile and world, for the same F, since selectedUnlocated is pointwise.
